description: List the agent's autopilot proposals — candidate actions it generated, each grounded in cited memories (provenance hydrated). Each proposal carries its id (needed for dryrun/execute/dismiss/undo/adjust), kind (create_alert | briefing | wallet_transfer), title, plain-language rationale (the receipt), params, confidence, requiresConfirmation, status, result, and the source memories. Filter by status to find what is actionable. Also returns the current config + trust for context. Read-only.

agentId.description: UUID of the three.ws agent whose proposals to list. Must be an agent owned by the credential.

status.description: Filter to one lifecycle status. Omit to return all statuses (newest first).

name: list_proposals
title: List autopilot proposals
